title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 96 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 96 - Deductions from Commission on Letter of Credit The person responsible for opening letter of credit for the purpose of importing goods for himself or any other person, while collecting commission on letter of credit, shall deduct 5% (five percent) tax from the money received as commission, Click here to see Bangla version Note: This is unofficial English translation. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
